text:
```yaml
name: Commands Workflow

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      command:
        description: 'The command to execute'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  makerelease:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run make-release script
        run: npm run make-release

  other-commands:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Execute custom command
        id: custom_command
        run: |
          case "${{ github.event.inputs.command }}" in
            "command1")
              # Command 1 logic here
              ;;
            "command2")
              # Command 2 logic here
              ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Unknown command"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
```
